title: Grain Accounting Manual: What a Buyout Comes To on a Grain Marketing Contract
content:
The buyout charge on a contract under Grain Marketing Contracts is the undelivered bushels taken at the release rate, at the loss multiplier and at the patron release factor, plus the administrative fee and the collection charge.

**The bushels.** The undelivered bushels are the bushels the contract commits less the net bushels the tickets standing against it, whatever the disposition, carry, struck in whole bushels, a part bushel taken to the nearest whole bushel and a half bushel taken upward, and never below zero.

**The five figures brought to them.** The release rate is the default penalty per bushel the member's marketing programme carries. The loss multiplier is the loss multiplier that programme carries. The patron release factor is one. The administrative fee is the flat administrative fee the programme carries. No collection charge is added.

**Rounding.** The charge is rounded to the cent once, on the figure reached after the undelivered bushels, the release rate, the loss multiplier, the patron release factor, the administrative fee and the collection charge have been brought together, and not at any earlier point.

**Where the bushels carry nothing.** Where the release rate, the loss multiplier and the patron release factor between them come to nothing, the bushels carry nothing and only the administrative fee and the collection charge are charged; the cooperative does not pay the member the difference.

## Worked through on hypothetical figures

A contract commits 30,000 bushels and the tickets standing against it, whatever the disposition, carry 18,000 net bushels. Assume the member's marketing programme carries a default penalty of 0.20 per bushel, a loss multiplier of 1.0 and a flat administrative fee of 150.00.

| Step | Hypothetical figure |
|---|---|
| Bushels the contract commits | 30,000 |
| Net bushels the tickets standing against it carry, whatever the disposition | 18,000 |
| Undelivered bushels, struck in whole bushels | 12,000 |
| Those bushels at the release rate, the loss multiplier and a patron release factor of one | 2,400.00 |
| Administrative fee | 150.00 |
| Collection charge | nil |

The charge is 2,550.00, rounded to the cent at that single point. On the same figures with a release rate of nothing, the bushels would carry nothing and the charge would be the 150.00 fee alone.
